images.purpose: RGB main platforms and interior facade
images.prompt:
Create a production 2D pixel-art spritesheet for a side-view platform game, RGB KEYBOARD CASTLE theme matching the reference. Reference image is style reference ONLY. Transparent RGBA background, no matte, no labels, no captions, no perspective. 1536 x 1024 landscape sheet, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equally sized cells, each 384 x 256. All isolated assets centered inside their own cell with 20px clear gutters. Pixel art with big crisp visibly square pixels, low native resolution look, limited palette dark graphite, charcoal, blue-gray, bright cyan and magenta LED strips. Heavy readable dark outlines, flat 2D side view, NO soft glow blur or antialiasing. Theme mechanical KEYCAP FORTRESS. Tiles must fit our stocky human 32x48-pixel game hero.
ROW1, left to right: (1) NORMAL PLATFORM a thin horizontal row of chunky dark keyboard keycaps on a metal beam, cyan and magenta little lights, flat safe upper edge; (2) OIL PLATFORM same thin beam but black IRIDESCENT OIL pool and streaky oily highlights over top, oily drips below, one small yellow/black hazard endplate; NOT ICE, not snow; (3) CRACKED PLATFORM same thin keycap row with clearly visible deep zigzag splits across upper keycaps, pieces still attached, NOT cloud and NOT translucent; (4) TIMER PLATFORM same thin metal beam with amber hazard stripes, electrical fuse corners and a small EMPTY black square counter housing hanging BELOW the exact middle, no numbers in housing.
ROW2: (1) MOVING PLATFORM, thin keyboard beam with cyan opposed chevrons; (2) TRAMPOLINE, dark mechanical keyboard base and bright magenta rubber top and 2 cyan springs; (3) GOAL PLATFORM, thin RGB keyboard beam with small gold corner trim, no flag; (4) THREE separate small LED pixel digits centered in row horizontally, exact text "3 2 1" white/pale-cyan dot-matrix digits, each numeral isolated with wide transparent gap.
ROW3: FOUR SQUARE INTERIOR FACADE TILE assets, each exactly same 192x192 pixel square size, squared full rectangular silhouette, NO outside transparent margin on the tile itself; (1) dark graphite keycap wall panel, 3 broad square stone/keyboard plates; (2) same edges and plates with recessed cyan-magenta circuit seam; (3) same dark square facade with a big tall open gothic window through the middle, center of the WINDOW must be fully TRANSPARENT so exterior parallax is visible; (4) square vent grille and recessed pipes, matching edges. Facade must be much DARKER than playable platforms. Square tile edges seamless and match adjacent panel tiles.
ROW4: (1) short horizontal RGB wall JOINT / ledge cap, solid dark graphite with a single cyan and magenta cable; (2) square window frame, transparent center, blue-gray metal arch and 2 upright keycap sides, no glass fill, matches facade; (3) thin upright mechanical pillar with cyan-magenta cable, no base or crown, continuation matches at top and bottom; (4) a little hanging cable and dark keycap banner decoration.
All platform assets in ROW1 and ROW2 columns1-3 are wide thin horizontal silhouettes, width approximately 340px and beam thickness 55-65px. Preserve enough negative space around each sprite for clean metadata slicing. No characters, no portals, no directional turning walls, no dirt/grass, no water/ice, no decorative scenery backdrop.

images.purpose: Separate cloud, far-castle and near-castle alpha layers
images.prompt:
Production transparent layered parallax sprite sheet for a coarse pixel-art 2D platformer. WIDE 1536x1024 image, exactly THREE horizontal strips stacked vertically with large transparent 35px gaps between strips. All THREE strips are SEPARATE layers on genuine RGBA transparency; do not render a composite landscape. No text, no labels, no characters, no UI. Visibly chunky crisp pixel art, native-resolution 256 pixel width magnified sixfold, dark graphite keyboard castle with cyan-magenta lights. Flat side-view orthographic environment silhouettes, no perspective receding floor.
TOP STRIP y40-300: ONLY distant pale lavender and pink pixel clouds, five flat cloud clusters across the width, bottom edge is completely transparent, above and between clouds also fully transparent. No sky color fill.
MIDDLE STRIP y390-650: ONLY distant city skyline of keyboard-keycap castle towers and gothic spires, desaturated muted indigo-violet, few tiny cyan lights, varying tower heights like medieval castle mixed with circuit boards. Lowest silhouette row sits on y650, fully transparent above roofs, skyline width almost full canvas.
BOTTOM STRIP y740-990: ONLY nearer dark keyboard-castle buttresses and industrial rooftop silhouette, charcoal plum, large squared keycap shapes, pipes with restrained cyan and fuchsia traces, broad shallow silhouette, transparent above roofs and in the gaps.
All silhouettes should be materially different in shape between strips for independent side-scrolling parallax, upper cloud strip soft and light in value but pixel sharp, distant city muted and low contrast, close architecture darker. Large simple readable masses, no fine noise, no blurry gradients or glow. Standalone isolated layers, transparent outside each painted object, not a black background.

images.purpose: Transparent derivative of the only opaque source sheet; original preserved
images.prompt: Edit target: the attached eight-piece castle wall spritesheet. Remove ONLY the opaque pure black background and make it genuinely transparent RGBA, including spaces between fragments and internal gaps. Preserve the exact image dimensions 1448x1086, the 4 column by 2 row layout, positions, character of the pixel art, black/navy outlines, cream keycaps, orange cables, green and orange lights, and every silhouette. Do not redesign or add/remove any structural part. No checkerboard, no black/white matte, no text. This is a background removal for actual Unity Tile Palette sprites, keep the eight pieces at their existing positions and proportions.
